payload.rationale: Selected top-5 candidates per profile by U score, ensuring >=3 distinct lambda ranks for diversity. Expression profile favors low-lambda high-CAI sources; stability profile picks large-lambda stable constructs; balanced profile mixes middle lambdas. Tie for U=0.792 in balanced resolved by layer-2 stability (ld1 more stable). All candidates pass all constraints.
